article_manifest.summary: The Malian Army announced the implementation of military operations in several areas of the country, which resulted in the targeting of a fuel depot northeast of Infrac, and a site for a gathering of armed elements west of Aguelhok, in addition to neutralizing a group of gunmen on motorcycles in the Dioula region in the south of the country. He said in an official statement on Sunday that the Malian armed forces, with the support of its partners, continue to monitor, sweep and secure the national territory within the framework of Operation Dogokoloko.

article_manifest.title: FAMa Offensive: Fuel Depot and Terrorist Groupings Precisely Destroyed
article_manifest.original_title: Offensive des FAMa : Un dépôt de carburant et des regroupements terroristes détruits avec précision
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . As a continuation of the offensive in the Eastern Theater, the ongoing sweeping operations have located, 8 km northeast of Inafarak, a fuel depot belonging to the armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.original_title: Suspect arrested over farmer’s killing, kidnapping in Niger
article_manifest.summary: The police have arrested a 29-year-old man who allegedly contracted kidnappers to abduct and kill a large-scale farmer in Zawudna village, Munya Local Government Area, and took over the deceased’s farmland. The police said Godwin Yahaya was arrested following allegations by rescued kidnapping victims that he conspired with kidnappers to abduct the farmer, Jonah Isah, and others for ransom.

article_manifest.title: Massive Fuel Flow in Bamako: Over 5,300 Tanks Delivered Successfully!
article_manifest.original_title: Flux massif de carburant à Bamako : Plus de 5 300 citernes livrées avec succès !
article_manifest.summary: More than 5,300 tankers delivered in Bamako since September! This Saturday, October 10, 2026, a new convoy of 957 tankers arrived in the capital, escorted by our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). The numbers speak for themselves: * September 2026 : 3,796 tankers arrived in Bamako in five convoys, including a record 1,289 tanks .
